projection.source: current persisted Trainer or group inventory scope plus current controlled Trainer/Pokémon destinations and exact revisions

flows.handoff: existing sheet item declaration and item-operation journal
flows.behavior: opens the existing exact target/choice decision; no parallel item mechanics path
moves one exact current whole item into one server-issued compatible Trainer slot and reviewed configuration; the client never authors configuration JSON
moves one exact current whole item into one selected linked Pokémon Held Item destination and server-issued reviewed configuration when required

flows.handoff: existing Trainer-to-group or group-to-Trainer inventory transfer
flows.behavior: moves one bounded quantity selected from the exact stable source row in either direction
opens app-relative reference information and mutates nothing

commitAuthority.declaration: strict schema-v1 declaration must exactly match one current server-issued offer, source, destination, quantity, confirmation, and every source/destination revision requirement
commitAuthority.equipment: the existing equipment operation reloads custody, reviewed definition, exact server-issued slot and configuration, compatibility, equipment state, reservations, and all affected sheet revisions before atomic commit
commitAuthority.transfer: the existing transfer use case reloads both inventories, stable source identity, unreserved quantity, and both revisions before one transaction
commitAuthority.responses: authoritative affected sheet and group documents replace local state and realtime events invalidate every other authorized client

interaction.composition: 60/40 inventory and bounded decision workspace, collapsing to one column
interaction.controls: one compact rectangular action strip for Use, Equip, Give, Transfer, and Inspect; group transfers reuse the same inline decision instead of a bespoke dialog
interaction.uncertainBoundary: exact retry is the only enabled decision and cancellation, refresh, and competing mutations are blocked
